summary: Jim Shadid, 79, went missing Sept 3, 2023 around 4pm while scouting for elk near Purgatory (Hermosa Creek drainage, Elbert Creek Rd / Little Creek Trail near Line Canyon); La Plata County SAR and the Sheriff's Department searched 8+ days with helicopters, drones, horses, K9 dogs, motorcycles, ATVs, and hundreds of volunteers; daily operations ceased Sept 11 and the mission became recovery; organized efforts concluded Sept 26 with no trace; body never recovered.
location: Hermosa Creek drainage near Purgatory (Elbert Creek Rd / Little Creek Trail near Line Canyon)
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue; La Plata County Sheriff's Department
notes: Search updates 9/5, 9/6, 9/7, 9/8, 9/9, 9/11, 9/26/2023 and Jan 13, 2024 (Celebration of Life). Family site typoed the year as 2022 in one spot; all dated updates are Sept 2023 and Sunday Sept 3 was 2023.
